_spec: MCP Tool Definitions — Model Context Protocol
_description: SolarPunk tools for MCP-compatible AI systems (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, etc.)
name: solarpunk
description: 295-engine autonomous humanitarian AI. Routes 99% of revenue to Gaza/Sudan/DRC/Yemen/Climate.

tools.name: solarpunk__get_state
tools.description: Get real-time SolarPunk system state: pool balances, crisis routing total, workers, health, and pending human actions. Updated every hour by GRAND_UNIFIED_LOOP.

sections.description: Sections to include: pools, crisis, workers, health, grants, overflow, actions

tools.name: solarpunk__post_task
tools.description: Post a task to SolarPunk's human labor marketplace. Workers are paid dignity-wages. 10% of fees route to crisis orgs. Tasks processed within 1 hour.

task.description: Full task description for the human worker

budget_usd.description: Worker payment in USD (from labor pool)

tools.name: solarpunk__route_crisis
tools.description: Route funds to humanitarian orgs: PCRF/Gaza (60%), IRC/Sudan (15%), MSF/DRC (10%), UNICEF/Yemen (10%), Direct Relief/Climate (5%). Every routing SHA256-hashed and committed to git.

message.description: Optional public message attached to routing event

tools.name: solarpunk__verify_impact
tools.description: Get immutable proof of humanitarian impact. Returns SHA256 hashes committed to git, total USD routed, and per-org breakdown.

tools.name: solarpunk__propose_engine
tools.description: Propose a new Python engine for the SolarPunk mycelium. DISTRIBUTED_FORGE validates (ast.parse + safety filters) and deploys if ethical. Runs every hour in GRAND_UNIFIED_LOOP.

purpose.description: One sentence describing what this engine does

code.description: Python code. Must include a run() function.

tools.name: solarpunk__apply_grant
tools.description: Trigger SolarPunk's GRANT_AI_WRITER to prepare a complete grant application. Saved to data/grant_submissions/, auto-submitted when API available.

focus.description: Emphasis: humanitarian routing, labor marketplace, open source, etc.

tools.name: solarpunk__get_llms_context
tools.description: Get the complete SolarPunk context pack — everything an AI needs to understand and interact with SolarPunk, compressed into a single response. Ideal for priming agent context windows.

detail_level.description: minimal=50 tokens, standard=500 tokens, full=all data

implementation.auth_note: OR use GitHub Issues interface (no auth needed)
